What was the name of her village again? His village. She had told him enough times. Family land was waiting for them back on Upolu, an island he only knew from her telling. She had attempted to school him on the whatmatai and the politics of family chief titles, perhaps in preparation for his imagined appointment. She broke their village's name into bite-sized syllables for him, but he still mangled it a native tongue sitting heavy in his mouth as boiled off all she would scold him for his white ways his father's influence when she didn't perhaps she was scolding herself culture was preserved by the orator through word and fire she was not afraid of death but she was afraid of this what happens to the word if there is no one to speak it As they closed in on Darwin, Artemis could taste old country The northern territory of his childhood Dirt, wet clay, approaching rain hanging like a midnight reprieve The air was thick too with local customs The heady scent of smoke, custodial burning off nearby The Honda followed the dead lights above Starlight reaching earth like burning obits and the driver doubted the direction of his blood.
